theme: 관광객을 위한 문화자산의 선택 — 가장 인상적인 것만

overview.stance_reason: 'a process of selection of cultural assets takes place'처럼 현상을 객관적으로 설명·분석함
overview.structure_reason: 관광객이 제한된 자산만 이용한다는 주장 뒤 'The reason is to be found in the fact that'로 근거를 제시함

key_grammar.source_sentence: The reason is to be found in the fact that tourist experience in cities is measured in days and hours, even in minutes in the case of cultural attractions or seconds in particular sites.

explanation.text: the fact 뒤의 that은 '~라는'으로 the fact의 내용을 그대로 풀어주는 동격 접속사예요.
동격 that 뒤에는 주어·동사가 다 갖춰진 '완전한 절'이 옵니다.
관계대명사 that/which는 뒤 문장에 빠진 자리가 있지만, 동격 that은 빠진 자리가 없어요.
동격 that은 관계대명사 which로 바꿀 수 없습니다.

key_grammar.example_analysis: the fact 를 뒤의 완전한 절(tourist experience in cities is measured in days and hours)이 동격으로 부연 설명한다.

drills.question: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?
drills.sentence: The reason [[1|is to be found]] in [[2|the fact which]] tourist experience in cities [[3|is measured]] in days and hours, even in minutes [[4|in the case of]] cultural attractions or seconds in [[5|particular]] sites.
drills.fix: 뒤에 완전한 절이 오는 동격절 자리이므로 관계대명사 which가 아니라 the fact that의 that이어야 함.

drills.question: 각 네모 안에서 어법에 맞는 것을 고르시오.
drills.sentence: The main difference between the selection of cultural assets [[made / making]] for locals and the one made for tourists is [[that / what]] in the second case, only a small choice [[is made / makes]] among the largest, most impressive and unique resources.

drills.question: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
drills.answer: As a result of this, a process of selection of cultural assets take place since only a few buildings and only a small number of social representations are able to be adapted to the tourist visit.
drills.fix: take → takes: 주어 a process(단수)에 수일치.
options: Tourists make intense and short-term use of a very limited number of historical assets and cultural attractions, including material and non-material ones.
The reason is to be found in the fact that tourist experience in cities is measured in days and hours, even in minutes in the case of cultural attractions or seconds in particular sites.
In addition, cultural tourists do not often repeat their visit to the same place, and therefore they are continuously looking for new attractions.
As a result of this, a process of selection of cultural assets take place since only a few buildings and only a small number of social representations are able to be adapted to the tourist visit.

The main difference between the selection of cultural assets made for locals and the one made for tourists is that in the second case, only a small choice is made among the largest, most impressive and unique resources.

drills.question: 그가 늦었다는 사실이 모두를 놀라게 했다.
drills.answer: The fact that he was late surprised everyone.

drills.question: 게다가, 문화 관광객은 같은 장소를 자주 반복 방문하지 않으며, 따라서 그들은 끊임없이 새로운 명소를 찾는다.
drills.answer: In addition, cultural tourists do not often repeat their visit to the same place, and therefore they are continuously looking for new attractions.

misreads.statement: 관광객은 물질적·비물질적인 것을 포함해 매우 제한된 수의 역사·문화 자산만 집중적으로 이용한다.
관광객이 소수의 자산만 이용하는 이유는 입장료가 비싸기 때문이다.
misreads.anchor: tourist experience in cities is measured in days and hours
misreads.why: 제한 이용의 이유는 관광 시간이 짧기 때문이지 입장료는 지문에 언급이 없음

mistips: make use of는 make와 use of가 형용사 때문에 떨어져 있어도 한 덩어리('이용하다')로 읽는다.

sentences.english: The reason is to be found in the fact that tourist experience in cities is measured in days and hours, even in minutes in the case of cultural attractions or seconds in particular sites.

grammar.note: is to be found: be동사+to부정사 수동형
the fact that ~: ~라는 사실 (동격절, 뒤에 완전한 절)

chunks.en: The reason is to be found
[[in the fact that tourist experience in cities]]
is measured in days and hours,
even in minutes in the case of cultural attractions
or seconds in particular sites.

misreads.statement: 관광 경험이 날·시간 단위로 측정되는 것은 관광객이 소수의 자산만 이용한 결과이다.
misreads.anchor: The reason is to be found in the fact that
misreads.why: 짧은 관광 시간이 제한 이용의 '원인(이유)'이지 그 결과가 아님 — 인과 역전

mistips: is to be found는 '찾아진다/발견된다'는 수동 의미이고, the fact that 이하가 그 내용을 동격으로 설명한다.

sentences.english: As a result of this, a process of selection of cultural assets takes place since only a few buildings and only a small number of social representations are able to be adapted to the tourist visit.

misreads.statement: 관광객의 방문에 맞춰질 수 있는 것은 소수의 건물뿐이고 사회적 표상은 전혀 포함되지 않는다.
misreads.anchor: only a small number of social representations are able to be adapted to the tourist visit
misreads.why: 사회적 표상도 '소수'는 관광 방문에 맞춰질 수 있다고 했으므로 전무는 아님

mistips: takes place의 주어는 앞의 a process (단수)이므로 takes. 사이의 수식어(of selection of cultural assets)에 속지 말 것.

sentences.english: The main difference between the selection of cultural assets made for locals and the one made for tourists is that in the second case, only a small choice is made among the largest, most impressive and unique resources.

grammar.note: made for locals/tourists: 과거분사가 명사 수식 (~을 위해 만들어진)
the one = the selection (앞 명사 대신)
a small choice is made: 선택이 이루어지다 (be+p.p.)

chunks.en: The main difference between the selection of cultural assets
[[made for locals and the one made for tourists]]

among the largest, most impressive and unique resources.

misreads.statement: 지역민용 선택과 관광객용 선택은 다르며, 관광객용은 자원의 규모와 무관하게 무작위로 이루어진다.
misreads.anchor: only a small choice is made among the largest, most impressive and unique resources
misreads.why: 차이가 있다는 방향은 맞지만, 관광객용은 '가장 크고 인상적인' 자원 중 소수를 고르는 것이지 무작위가 아님

misreads.statement: 위 문장에서 the second case는 지역민을 위한 선택을 가리킨다.
misreads.anchor: the one made for tourists is that in the second case
misreads.why: the second case는 두 번째로 언급된 '관광객을 위한 선택'을 가리킴

mistips: the one made for tourists = the selection made for tourists. one은 앞의 selection을 대신한다.
the second case는 뒤에 나온 관광객용 선택(두 번째로 언급된 것)을 가리킨다.
